name: optical-calculator
description: 머신비전 광학 계산기 — 웹(PWA)과 안드로이드 APK 를 같은 소스로 만든다

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs
scripts.android:init: npx cap add android && node scripts/patch-android.mjs && python scripts/android_icons.py
scripts.apk: npm run sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs debug && node scripts/collect-apk.mjs
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && node scripts/build-apk.mjs release && node scripts/collect-apk.mjs
